title: UAAP: Red-hot Acido leads UST past FEU to end three-game skid
summary: Amiel Acido caught fire as University of Santo Tomas outlasted Far Eastern University, 86-85, to snap a three-game skid in UAAP Season 89 men's basketball on Sunday at the Araneta Coliseum in Cubao.
